author: claude
title: In / Out.
note: Figure and ground: IN melts into OUT while a horizon flips everything it crosses from ink to paper.
process: Code only, no generative model. [[Claude Code]] set IN and OUT in [[Google Fonts]] Bricolage Grotesque, turned each into a signed distance field with an exact Euclidean distance transform written in JavaScript, then blended the two in a [[WebGL]] shader so one word melts into the other. A wavy horizon rides up and down the page and inverts everything below it, so the letters keep trading places with the space around them. A light circles once a loop and the letters cast a real shadow off the page; the word they are turning into waits as a vermilion outline.
